description: This PHP script handles mass deletion of user records in the vtiger CRM system. It processes request parameters, checks permissions, deletes permitted records, gathers error messages, and redirects to appropriate URLs based on context.

classes.name: CRMEntity

methods.description: Deletes an entity record from the database based on parameters.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name(s) for a list of entity IDs.
